column3: Verifier can't finish within its own 1800 s timeout. The untouched suite (all 24 tests in cortex/tests/test_dataset.py, not just the target test) is CPU-bound rendering: pycortex quickshow shells out to inkscape for SVG->PNG. Timed out 6/6 at 4 GB (eval), 6/6 at 2 vCPU and 4/4 at 4 vCPU (profiling, 2026-10-08/09); 17 min of tests alone at 2 vCPU with both cores saturated (34 CPU-min, 11 s sys), so thread caps don't help. Excluded rather than patched: fixing it means a longer timeout plus more vCPU for one task, or editing the tests.
